text:
sophie: pushed a new PR with compact SDK examples for streaming+pagination across py/ts/go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/499. Main goals: normalize resume token usage, show deadline patterns, and add tiny knob cheat-sheet. please skim.
matt: thanks. quick scan — go snippets failed go vet in CI earlier? I saw a compile error in the stream helper.
kevin: yea, CI showed `undefined: stream.Event` in go example because the helper import path was wrong. fixing to `streaming.Event`.
sophie: updated imports, reran snippet smoke tests locally. also changed all pagination examples to use `cursor: ""` (empty string) as canonical start value and added a short note under "Resume tokens" explaining that `""` == start-of-list.
matt: prefer documenting the behavior: empty string means no server-side cursor, server returns first page and a resume token when available. small wording suggestion will push to PR.
natalie: for Python can we prefer `async for item in client.responses.stream(...)` pattern instead of manual `while True` loop? less error-prone. show asyncio.wait_for for per-request timeout.
kevin: updated py snippet: ```py
async def fetch(q):
    async for chunk in client.responses.stream(model='redwood-mini', input=q):
        handle(chunk)
# per-call deadline
await asyncio.wait_for(fetch(q), timeout=0.25)
```
sophie: nice. TS example should show AbortController + example backpressure where client stops reading after reaching N tokens.
matt: added TS snippet and commented that `signal.abort()` will close upstream but still flush server-side partial tokens. snippet: ```ts
const ac = new AbortController();
const s = client.responses.stream({model: 'redwood-mini', input: q, signal: ac.signal});
let got = 0;
for await (const p of s) { process(p); got++; if (got >= 50) ac.abort(); }
```
kevin: one more nit: pagination example mixed `null` and `""` for cursor in older snippets. good call to unify. also added a tiny knob-matrix under examples: batching / cache-TTL / deadline mapping to effect (throughput/latency/cost).
sophie: added that small matrix inline and a 3-line migration note for folks upgrading from v1 snippets (main change: cursor default). also updated links that pointed to the old paginate doc; fixed to the stable slug.
docs-bot: PR 499 updated: snippet compilation checks passed, docs linter green.
matt: did we add a short troubleshooting FAQ entry for "why my resume token looks long"? sometimes users paste base64 and get confused.
natalie: added short FAQ: resume tokens are opaque strings; treat them as tokens to pass back to `cursor` field. if confused, call the debug endpoint or enable verbose logs.
kevin: LGTM from me.
sophie: merging in 20 unless objections. thanks y'all. :shipit:
matt: lgtm
natalie: lgtm
sophie: will monitor release-notes bot and open follow-up if users need expanded examples.
